about:
Savor Street Foods Inc. maintains its headquarters in Reading, Pennsylvania, where the company was established in 1884. With a founding date that predates the 20th century, the business has accumulated over 130 years of continuous operation in the artisan snack category. Public records do not disclose the identities of the original founders, nor do they specify whether the company remains family-owned, veteran-owned, or held under another ownership structure.

The manufacturer focuses on the production of artisan snacks, and it advertises the capacity to produce items that meet certified gluten-free and kosher standards. The input does not detail the specific baking processes, the size of the production facility, the number of employees, or the typical order volumes handled.

The company describes its target market as a new generation of consumers with sophisticated palates who are pursuing healthy lifestyles. However, the available data does not identify particular industries served, such as retail, foodservice, or private-label partners, nor does it name any specific customers.

Savor Street frames its long history as a competitive advantage, applying its century of snack-baking experience to modern dietary trends. Beyond the gluten-free and kosher capabilities, no further differentiators — such as proprietary recipes, rapid turnaround times, or specialized packaging — are mentioned in the source.
